title: Invalid State Transition on Cancelled Order
description: Fulfills order without verifying if state is already terminal (CANCELLED or REFUNDED).
vulnerable_code:
def fulfill_order(order):
    # Vulnerable: Missing state validation; transitions cancelled orders to FULFILLED
    order.status = "FULFILLED"
    order.save()
    dispatch_shipment(order)

ground_truth.description: State transition to FULFILLED without validating current lifecycle state.
ground_truth.explanation: Allows shipping cancelled or refunded orders because state pre-conditions are omitted.

expected_evidence.description: Direct state assignment without precondition assertion.
